brief.text: 中文深度研究：面向懂投资但不熟悉光掩模的读者，解释价值链及上下游参与者、关键技术壁垒、中国与全球差距、需求与风险、研发到客户验证到量产；比较清溢光电、路维光电、龙图光罩。用2025全年作为可比财务期间，后续建设/认证进展注明披露日期。不做股价预测或交易建议。制作实用公司比较表和有证据支持的图表。明确公司总收入与半导体业务收入不能混同，单片验证、成套供货、设备布局、未来计划分别表述。
brief.execution_guidance: Start fresh: use original source tools and new research notes; do not reuse rehearsal outputs. Initial corpus has five primary issuer sources; acquire a few additional primary sources only for material gaps. Prefer one industry task and one scoped three-company comparison task within the shared research deadline. Explain missing coverage rather than invent facts. Keep company-wide financial comparison concise and separate from long technical-state descriptions. Clearly attribute issuer-only industry assessments in conclusions; label secondary forecasts/actual figures and dates, or omit unnecessary macro estimates. Request figures with complete source IDs. No native pixel access is promised to the independent reviewer; the operator will inspect exports.
